sentences.en: The snake is long and thin.
A mouse is small.
An elephant is big.
The mountain is high.
The river is wide and deep.
The ice is thick on the lake.
This paper is very thin.
The table is round.
The land is flat here.
Is this box big enough for all the things?
sentences.zh: 这个盒子够大来装所有东西吗？

sentences.en: The road is long and straight.
The water in this part is deep.
Do not go in.
The window is low to the ground.
I need a long piece of string.
The two lines are parallel to each other.
The curve of the road was sharp.
The distance between the two towns is ten miles.
sentences.zh: 两个城镇之间的距离是十英里。

sentences.en: The sticky substance on the table was glue.
sentences.zh: 桌子上的粘性物质是胶水。

sentences.en: The cloth had a stiff texture.
The weight of the box was not great.
A square has four equal sides.
sentences.zh: 正方形有四条相等的边。

sentences.en: The solid ice did not break.
The mass of the rock was great.
Elastic material goes back to its old shape.
sentences.zh: 弹性材料会恢复原来的形状。

sentences.en: The limit of the land is the river.
The fat man was the same size as the door.
sentences.zh: 那个胖男人和门一样大。
